subject: Ingo Horse Race
text: Challenging Ingo to a horse race costs a bet of 50 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
Speak to Ingo and he will ask if you want to bet 
50 Rupees on a race, you certainly do.

subject: Obstacle Course
text: Beating the Lon Lon Ranch obstacle course with a time of 0:49 or better rewards Link with a cow delivered to his house in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
speak to Malon two times, she will offer to let you race 
and obstacle course.  The time to beat is 50 Seconds...Assuming you 
get a time of 0:49 or better then Malon will give you a present...The present 
is in fact a whole cow that now lives in your house in Kokiri Forest.

subject: Dampe's Race
text: Finishing the race against Dampe's ghost under the grave next to the magic bean sprout in Kakariko Village Graveyard awards the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Head to the Kakariko Village Graveyard as Adult Link and move the tombstone 
next to the magic bean sprout.  You will reveal a hole that you can drop down 
and find Dampe's ghost there.  Agree to race him and you have two goals, 
finish the race to get the HOOKSHOT and finish the race in under one minute to 
get the PIECE OF HEART [019].

subject: Dampe's Race
text: Finishing Dampe's race in under one minute awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
finish the race in under one minute to 
get the PIECE OF HEART [019].

subject: Big Poe
text: Catching Big Poes requires riding Epona and using the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote:
First of all, in order to catch the Big Poes you must be riding Epona and you 
must have the Fairy Bow.

subject: Ghost Shop
text: The ghost shop owner at the entrance to Hyrule Castle Town awards 100 points per Big Poe and requires 1000 points from ten Big Poes for his special prize.

evidence.quote:
He says that you'll 
get a special prize once you reach 1000 points, and since each Poe nets you 
100 points, that means you must collect a total of ten.

subject: Big Poe
text: The tenth Big Poe appears when riding past a lone tree located north of the path fork southeast of Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote:
north of that fork there 
is a lone tree and when you ride past this tree, the tenth BIG POE will appear 
and allow you to capture it.

subject: Ghost Shop
text: Presenting the tenth Big Poe to the ghost shop man in Hyrule Castle Town rewards the fourth and final Empty Bottle along with 500 Rupees earned in total.

evidence.quote:
Enter the small room and 
present the final Poe to the ghost man, he will give you the fourth and final 
EMPTY BOTTLE in return for you work.  Coupled with the 500 Rupees you have 
already made from it

subject: Froggy Minigame
text: From left to right, the frogs in the Zora's River minigame correspond to controller inputs A, Left, Down, Up, and Right.

evidence.quote:
(from left to right, the frog buttons 
are A, left, down, up, right).

subject: Froggy Minigame
text: Successfully inputting the complete frog note sequence awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: left, A).  Doing this will net you a reward, the PIECE OF HEART [030].

subject: Cucco Lady
text: The Cucco breeding woman gives Link the Pocket Egg, which hatches into a Pocket Cucco after playing the Sun's Song twice.

evidence.quote:
She gives you the POCKET EGG which will hatch 
overnight just like the other egg.  After acquiring it, play the Sun's Song 
once, and then again to make the egg hatch into a POCKET CUCCO.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Using the Pocket Cucco to wake sleeping Talon in a Kakariko house makes the Cucco happy, prompting the lady to reward Link with Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
In here you will find Talon sleeping on a bed.  Stand 
beside him with your new Pocket Cucco equipped on one of the C Buttons and use 
it...she gives 
you COJIRO, a special Blue Cucco which has stopped crowing entirely.

subject: Sleeping Man
text: Using Cojiro in front of the sleeping man by the stump in the Lost Woods rewards the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote:
There 
is a man sitting beside the stump here in this area...equip the blue Cucco 
Cojiro on one of your C-Buttons and then use it while standing in front of the 
man...gives 
you the ODD MUSHROOM.

subject: Witch
text: Delivering the Odd Mushroom within three minutes to the witch behind the Kakariko Village Potion Shop yields the Odd Medicine.

evidence.quote:
You now have three minutes to get to the Potion 
Shop in Kakariko Village...enter the other door back there, it will take you to a 
witch.  Use the Odd Mushroom while standing in front of her and she will give 
you the ODD MEDICINE.

subject: Lost Woods Girl
text: Giving the Odd Medicine to the girl standing at the stump in the Lost Woods yields the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
Go to where the man was sitting previously and there you 
will find a small girl.  Stand in front of her and use the Odd Medicine to 
acquire the POACHER'S SAW.

subject: Master Craftsman's Son
text: Crossing the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley with the Longshot and trading the Poacher's Saw to the man yields the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Approach the bridge which is 
totally broken and equip the Longshot.  Use the Longshot to hook onto the 
target on the other side and get across.  When you do this, go and speak to 
the fat guy here.  Equip the Poacher's Saw onto one of your C buttons and use 
it while standing in front of him.  He'll offer you the BROKEN GORON'S SWORD 
in return for the Poacher's Saw.
